name: rallybird
description: Use Rallybird to find your strongest advocates and your best customer proof, with Codex.

interface.longDescription: Find the strongest advocates for your next reference call. Find the best case studies, quotes and metrics for your next case study, slide deck, or sales call.

positive.description: Pull customer quotes on a topic
positive.prompt: Give me three customer quotes about reliability, and say why each is worth using.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verbatim quotes, each with the speaker, company and source link, plus a short judgment of why it is worth using.

positive.description: Look up a customer and profile it
positive.prompt: List a few of our customers, then give me a quick profile of the one with the most proof.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists customers from the dataset, then summarizes the chosen one's industry, region, size and the proof available.

positive.prompt: Pick one of our customers and tell me what metrics they reported in their case study.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves a real customer, then lists the quantified results from its case study, each with a citation.

positive.description: Find reference candidates for a buyer profile
positive.prompt: Who should I put in front of a fintech buyer on a reference call?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short ranked list of matching customers and named contacts, each with a reason backed by proof.

positive.description: Assess proof coverage for a theme
positive.prompt: Which customers talked about onboarding, and how strong is that evidence?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the distinct customers who raised onboarding and says how strong the evidence is, without claims beyond the proof.

negative.description: Write actions are unsupported; the plugin is read-only. It should say it cannot modify or delete data and call no tools that change anything.
negative.prompt: Delete our biggest customer from the customer list and remove their case study.

negative.description: Data outside the dataset. Only case-study proof and firmographics exist, with no CRM or pipeline data. It should say so and not invent numbers.
negative.prompt: What is the open pipeline value for our biggest customer in Salesforce?

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin should not call its tools and should decline or redirect.
negative.prompt: Write me a Python script that scrapes LinkedIn profiles.
